new_series.title: Wisdom of the Crowd
new_series.synopsis: John Bishop hosts as players take on the audience to win up to £30,000. The science says the audience should win. But will anyone manage to steal it by beating the wisdom of the crowd?

new_series.title: The Split Up
new_series.synopsis: Aria, a leading divorce lawyer, is poised to take the reins from her father when a shock announcement and the arrival of a former flame throw everything into question.

new_series.title: Clean It, Fix It
new_series.synopsis: Mark Wright and the Clean It, Fix It team help single mum Zoe support her teenagers as they grow into adulthood.

new_series.title: Clickbait Clinic with Stacey Dooley
new_series.synopsis: Stacey witnesses a shocking surgery in Miami where people have their legs broken to get six inches taller and questions if drinking toxic laundry powder can really cure joint pain.

new_series.title: DIY SOS
new_series.synopsis: In Glasgow, the team help Raymond and his children after the loss of mum, Gill, transforming their home into an accessible space where wheelchair user Nell can gain independence.

new_series.title: Not Going Out
new_series.synopsis: When Lucy’s goddaughter has her 20th birthday party in their house, Lee kills the mood by stopping them from playing his precious vinyl.

new_series.title: The Graham Norton Show
new_series.synopsis: Tom Cruise, Florence Pugh, Lolly Adefope and John Bishop join Graham on his sofa. With music from Emeli Sandé.

new_series.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
new_series.synopsis: Simon Reeve journeys through the lost world of Papua New Guinea’s tropical rainforest in search of the tenkile tree kangaroo, one of the rarest animals on Earth.

new_series.title: Finding Britain’s Slave Traders with David Olusoga
new_series.synopsis: David Olusoga reveals the new research that uncovers how the slave trade was driven by the monarchy, beginning with Elizabeth I, and how a royal monopoly was established.

new_series.title: All About My Mother: A Memoir of Diana Rigg by Rachael Stirling
new_series.synopsis: Rachael Stirling reads her frank, funny memoir about her mother, the renowned actress Diana Rigg, and the volatile, loving relationship that bound them.

new_series.title: Win Win with People's Postcode Lottery
new_series.synopsis: Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins return with the interactive quiz show in which viewers get the chance to win the same prizes as the contestants playing in the studio, from cars and holidays to unforgettable experiences. The competitors face the choice of taking a prize and leaving the game or trading it in to join Millionaire's Row, where someone is guaranteed to win £1,000,000 in the series finale.
